AccountSnapshot.description: Snapshot of an individual account within a multi-account provider.

ActionId.description: A unique identifier for a provider action (1–64 characters, `[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]`).

BillingDate.description:
Subscription renewal or expiration timestamp paired with whether the timestamp
represents a calendar date without a meaningful time-of-day.

Chart.description: A chart embedded in a detail section.

ChartPoint.description: A data point in a chart.

ClientInfo.description: Information identifying the client in the `hello` handshake message.

ClientMessage.description: Messages sent from client to server.

oneOf.description: Initial client handshake advertising supported protocols and client metadata.
Request an immediate usage snapshot push.

Confidence.description: Confidence level in a metric value.

Cost.description: Cost and spend tracking snapshot (e.g. extra usage spend cap and prepaid cloud balance).

CostDailyEntry.description: Single day in the 30-day token and cost ledger.

CostHistory.description:
Local or provider-reported token cost history for the card Cost section and
the Usage Breakdown chart submenu.

CostModelBreakdown.description: Per-model cost and token breakdown within a daily entry or rolling window.

CostProvenance.description: Provenance of reported token cost figures.

CostWindowSummary.description: Rolling comparison window summary (e.g. 7d / 14d / 30d) shown in the Cost section.

CreditLimit.description: Recurring credit limit allowance paired with a provider's credits balance.

balanceReadSucceeded.description: False when the balance read failed and `remaining` should not be rendered as a live number.

creditLimit.description: Recurring credit allowance limit and reset cadence, when the provider exposes one.

creditsAvailable.description: Whether credits can currently be spent on this account.

resetCredits.description: Instant-reset credit grants available on this account, when applicable.

DetailRow.description: A row within a detail section.

DetailSection.description: A section of detailed rows and optional chart.

EngineInfo.description: Information about the running engine daemon.

EngineSnapshot.description: Complete Snapshot v1 emitted by the AriadUsage engine.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was assembled.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version, fixed to 1 for Snapshot v1.

staleAfterSeconds.description: Seconds after which clients should consider this snapshot stale.

ErrorCode.description: Standard machine-readable error codes for IPC failures.

Identity.description: Identity and account provenance for a provider.

IpcError.description: Structured IPC error carrying a machine-readable code and static safe message.

MetricError.description: Diagnostic error attached to a metric.

NamedWindow.description: A named rate window for secondary/tertiary/custom provider allowances.

NoticeLevel.description: Severity level for asynchronous notice messages pushed by the server.

Pace.description: Pace metrics comparing consumption to linear time progression.

PlanUtilizationEntry.description: A single historical observation in a plan utilization series.

PlanUtilizationSeries.description:
Historical utilization series for a plan rate window (known series names:
`"session"`, `"weekly"`, `"monthly"`, `"opus"`, `"antigravityGemini"`,
`"antigravityClaudeGpt"`), backing the Plan Usage submenu and quota burndown chart.

ProviderError.description: A classified provider error with a safe message.

ProviderErrorKind.description: Classified error kinds matching CodexBar's error model.

ProviderId.description:
A unique identifier for a provider instance (1–64 characters, `[a-z0-9-]`).

Follows the same grammar and length restrictions as CodexBar's `ProviderInstanceID`.

ProviderPresentation.description:
Engine-owned labels and accent color that frontends use to title a
provider's usage windows and tint its progress bars.

accentColor.description: Provider accent color as uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex.

shortDisplayName.description: Compact provider name for tight layouts (e.g. "Anti").

tertiaryLabel.description: Title of the tertiary window, when the provider has one (e.g. "Sonnet").

ProviderSnapshot.description: Snapshot of a single AI provider's usage and state.

presentation.description:
Window titles and accent color for known providers; absent for
providers the engine has no descriptor for.

ProviderStatus.description: Full provider status page snapshot backing the card status banner and Status Page submenu.

ProviderWindows.description: Positional and named rate windows for a provider or account.

RateWindow.description: A rate window indicating quota consumption and reset timing.

nextRegenPercent.description: Percentage restored on next regeneration increment, if applicable.

pace.description: Per-window pace comparing consumption to elapsed window progress.

resetDescription.description: Human-readable description of reset timing (e.g. "Resets tomorrow at 9 AM").

sessionEquivalent.description: Session-equivalent forecast for weekly windows when primary session pace is known.

usedPercent.description: Percentage of quota consumed (raw, may exceed 100%).

windowMinutes.description: Duration of the window in minutes (e.g. 300 for 5 hours, 10080 for weekly).

RequestId.description: A unique identifier for a client request (1–64 characters, ASCII graphic characters).

ResetCredits.description: Instant-reset credit grants (e.g. Codex reset credits).

availableCount.description: Number of instant-reset credit grants available.

nextExpiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp of the next expiring reset credit grant.

RowProgress.description: Numeric ratio progress for a detail row.

RowSeverity.description: Display emphasis a provider assigns to a detail row.

SecretString.description:
A secret string that redacts itself in [`fmt::Debug`], does not implement [`fmt::Display`],
and zeroizes its memory buffer when dropped.

Serialized and deserialized as a standard string for wire transport (e.g. `setSecret` frame).

ServerMessage.description: Messages sent from server to client.

oneOf.description: Handshake response confirming negotiated protocol and engine capabilities.
Explicit response to a client request.
Pushed notification that settings in `scope` have changed.
Pushed system notice or desktop notification event.

SessionEquivalentForecast.description:
Session-equivalent forecast estimating how many full primary sessions the
remaining weekly headroom can cover at the current session pace.

estimatedSessions.description: Estimated number of primary-session equivalents remaining before reset.

sampleCount.description: Number of historical session samples used to compute the forecast, when available.

windowsUntilReset.description: Number of primary windows remaining before the weekly window resets.

SettingId.description: A unique identifier for a setting descriptor (1–64 characters, `[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]`).

SettingsScope.description: Target scope of a settings page.

SourceKind.description: Strategy kind that acquired the metric.

StatusComponent.description: Individual service component on a provider status page, with optional nested subcomponents.

SubscriptionDates.description: Subscription renewal and expiration dates for a provider or account.

Topic.description: Subscription topics supported by the IPC engine.
